name: Amazon CloudWatch Alarms
description: Production operational alarms for API health, paid-order fanout, inventory reservation release, critical worker DLQs, owner task backlog, and CloudFront availability.

alarms.name: ironwallengraving-api-5xx
alarms.description: Sustained API 5xx responses that can block checkout, admin, or storefront data flows.

alarms.name: ironwallengraving-payment-completed-outbox-publish-failures
alarms.description: Payment-completed outbox publishing is repeatedly failing, delaying paid-order fanout.

alarms.name: ironwallengraving-payment-completed-outbox-failed-rows
alarms.description: A paid-order fanout row reached terminal failure and needs manual attention.

alarms.name: ironwallengraving-inventory-reservation-release-blocked
alarms.description: Inventory reservation release is blocked, which can keep sellable stock unavailable.

alarms.name: ironwallengraving-itemStock-dlq-depth
alarms.description: Critical item stock worker messages have failed all retries.

alarms.name: ironwallengraving-customerConfirmation-dlq-depth
alarms.description: Critical customer confirmation messages have failed all retries.

alarms.name: ironwallengraving-ownerOrderTodo-dlq-depth
alarms.description: Critical owner to-do messages have failed all retries.

alarms.name: ironwallengraving-owner-order-todo-age
alarms.description: Paid-order owner task creation is backed up long enough to affect fulfillment visibility.

alarms.name: ironwallengraving-cloudfront-5xx
alarms.description: Sustained CloudFront 5xx rate high enough to indicate public storefront availability trouble.
